summary: Release v0.1.1: version bump in tauri.conf.json, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, package.json and package-lock.json; macOS build and zip made locally, Windows built by the tag-triggered release workflow.
scope_note: Owner asked to push and make v0.1.1 (2026-10-25). Contents since v0.1.0: no default project, offline demo project and guided tour, in-app update check, legacy default-project cleanup, PageTide rename and icon, settings tweaks, demo import and select-to-ask.
open_risks: Windows has never run on real hardware; the update chain (latest release -> download -> install) has never run against real GitHub. First check with the v0.1.0 app is not possible (it has no updater); the first real test is v0.1.1 -> a later release.
